tested_steps: Clicked 'Create pipe' on home page
Selected 'Create pipe from scratch'
Entered pipe name 'QA Test Pipe'
Clicked 'Create pipe' button
Verified redirect to pipe's Kanban board
Confirmed 3 default phases: Inbox (0 cards), Doing (0 cards), Done (0 cards)
Verified auto-assigned color (yellow/gold)
Verified pipe title displayed in header
Navigated to pipe settings (Manage button)
Opened Phases editor
Clicked 'Advanced options' to view phase configuration
Verified phase name field: 'Inbox'
Verified color swatch (blue)
Verified description field
Verified checkboxes: 'Set as final phase', 'Allow creating cards in this phase'
Verified 'Manage tasks' radio options: 'Collect email addresses' / 'Do not collect'
Verified 'Add assignee' section
Verified 'Late alert' configuration with time and unit dropdowns
Navigated to Manage > Phases editor
Clicked 'Short text' field type in the palette
Field creation modal opened with field type selector
Entered field label: 'Test Field'
Clicked 'Save' button
Verified field was created and displayed in Fields section
Verified field shows type badge 'Short text'
Verified field has edit and delete actions
Attempted to create a card by clicking '+ Create new card' button
Modal appeared with title 'Share the card creation form'
Message displayed: 'This pipe's start form doesn't have any fields yet. Add at least one field before creating cards.'
Verified card creation is blocked until start form has fields
This confirms the requirement that cards require start form fields
Navigated to Databases tab on home page
Clicked 'Create database' tile
Database creation modal opened with name-only input
Entered database name: 'Test Database'
Clicked 'Create database' button
Verified redirect to database grid view
Confirmed database title: 'Test Database'
Verified empty state: '0 records' with 'No records yet' message
Confirmed 'Criar registro' (Create record) button is present
